---
title: "About"
---

Canawler is a public data project about the Chesapeake & Ohio Canal: its towpath,
locks, access points, visitor amenities, and selected canal-corridor features. It
focuses on a coherent, reproducible data foundation rather than personal progress
tracking or a comprehensive railroad-history inventory.

## Provenance

The current reference inputs draw from:

- the National Park Service Public Trails dataset for towpath geometry;
- the NPS C&O Canal Recreational Guide by Milepost for places and amenities;
- the C&O Canal Association access guide for practical access locations; and
- NPS and C&O Canal Trust lock references for numbering, mileposts, and names.

Canawler performs normalization, deterministic ID assignment, reference matching,
linear referencing, relationship generation, and validation. Those derived facts
are identified separately from source facts in the [source registry](data/public/json/sources.json).

The data supports exploration and analysis. It is not a navigation product and
should not be treated as current trail-condition guidance.
